reason: Post-freeze parent audit of the original SCAR publication/repository showed that a background-aware structure-abduction prompt is a stronger fair parent than a bare direct mapping prompt. No P2 model outputs or full-corpus confirmatory results were accessed before this amendment.

strongest_parent_update.P1_DIRECT_MODEL: same qualified model, exact direct decision/mapping prompt
strongest_parent_update.P2_PUBLISHED_STYLE_STRUCTURE_ABDUCTION: same qualified model, asks it to infer the cross-system relational/process structure before deciding/mapping, but does not supply ORION's typed applicability, source-span, boundary/QoI or fail-closed witness schema
strongest_parent_update.C1_GROUNDED_STRUCTURAL_WITNESS: same qualified model, explicit ORION directional applicability and exact source-span grounding schema
strongest_parent_update.comparison_rule: C1 must clear its hard safety/grounding gates and show its primary residual against max(P1,P2) on each relevant quality coordinate. A win over P1 alone is insufficient if P2 matches or wins.

published_parent_anchors.SCAR_paper_claim: The SCAR publication reports that background/explanation and chain-of-thought style structure abduction can improve analogy mapping, so this mechanism class must be represented in the parent set rather than attributed to ORION.

matched_resource_contract.same_retry_policy: one syntax-only retry if and only if #447 qualified interface itself permits it; otherwise zero

acquisition_and_case_order.SCAR_case_rule: one non-quarantined English system analogy -> one positive mapping case
acquisition_and_case_order.ProParaLogy_case_rule: one non-quarantined row -> a paired block containing true target, challenging distractor and random target; role identity remains protected evaluator state and never candidate-visible

missing_evidence_controls.selection: lowest 50 SHA-256 ranks of non-quarantined ProPara source-row identities under seed 202608141701
missing_evidence_controls.construction: retain source text but replace target paragraph with a fixed statement that the target mechanism evidence is unavailable

acquisition_and_case_order.manifest_binding: All three outputs must be SHA-256 recorded before any model call. Public cases contain opaque ids/text only; protected gold contains source row, role and mappings/decision.
